notes.title: Some news about latest major update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We are still working hard on the latest major update.

You may have also noticed that there are new Achievements in Steam, but they can only be unlocked in the new update, we apologize for the inconvenience. (Also the bug with the career trick on Xbox will be fixed in the next update).

Approximate release date of the update May-June. PS5 port is expected closer to the end of the year due to technical difficulties with dev kit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/9aa84a0b8df8f1f3bb011f30467e855e94756ee9.jpg[/img]

Also, we present the screenshot (WIP) of one of the largest city maps in TRAIL OUT - Tokyo. Big speeds, detailed city center with different weather and time of day are waiting for you very soon! 

Also I want to remind you that we are recycling the career and it will make more sense to replay the game again.

[i]Johann Hirsch
Team leader of Good Boys.[/i]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE | Last Pursuit and TRAIL OUT v3.0!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello drivers! [/b]

[previewyoutube=kD21xldh5fY;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been a while since we've seen you, but the [b]Xbox release happened[/b] and we've been preparing a major update in honor of it! Introducing [b]Last Pursuit[/b] update with [b]Trail Out v3.0[/b]! The second [b]major update[/b] in the history of the game, adding a lot of new content and updating the hunter mode, turning it into a standalone mini game. [i]Yes, this is the 5 latest update.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/6246d88fa83a7601ffc612423453daa44b92a5cf.jpg[/img]

 [h2]⭐ Main changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New big map[/b]: [b]GOLDEN TRAIL[/b]! Experience the fall season in the mountains with a ride around the dam and factory.
[*][b] New game plus![/b] Try going through the game again with the drivers health system, 10 drivers during the race and other conditions.
[*] Big update for the [b]Hunter mode[/b] with the killstrike system!
[*] Also big update for the [b]DEAD OUT[/b] with split-screen for 2 players!
[*] [b]SPEED RADARS![/b] Stay on every Rush mode maps with online records and rewards. Who will be faster? Also you will get a small photo.
[*] [b]NEW CARS![/b] [b]Sturman Ex[/b] and fastest drag-car [b]Citra Super[/b]
[*] [b]Special vehicles[/b]: Tractor [b]JD 1960[/b], Lawnmower [b]Tor Slicer GT[/b] and small tractor [b]Pepes 12[/b], available with cheat codes. Also [b]Patriot[/b], old army suv.
[*] Added [b]dynamic weather[/b] for some large maps (snow, rain, sunny, fog) for Golden Trail, Black Lake, Hilly Valley, Nordloopring, Wildwood maps
[*] [b]Global rebalance[/b] of Free Race rewards. Rewards now converge with track length and time spent on the track. Escape and Hunter modes are also better balanced in rewards.
[*] Improved optimization with memory and other effects.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/ad5cfddd42eb9168d0d8162c371cc740e666e0f2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New update soon and release on Xbox X/S!
notes.notes:
Hello, drivers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/cedb7bae8db9b7aaa81eea01cf31ded0075a524b.jpg[/img]

The game is now available on the Xbox Series X/S and the release was good enough and we want to let you know that a major update and Trail Out version 3.0 is coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/5c054e2345d08e3b7b6133e33ec7a33485311c41.jpg[/img]

From the main new features it will be available NEW GAME +, for those who want to go through the game again, but under different conditions. You are given initially several cars and a new health system for drivers. Each driver has its own health in real-time, you need to heal and control more your money management. This is something we had planned before the release, but only got to finish today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/f53e52106e12b94026d01ec491220aaf715127df.jpg[/img]

Also will be available improved Hunter mode, with the ability to choose a car and call for reinforcements, like Killstrike system from the Call Of Duty series. Also changed the conditions of the mode and added some mode lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/3511525ef001f4dfb29322402c26f2683efa30a2.jpg[/img]

As well as a major new fall map located in the mountains of Canada - Golden Trail. Jumping, racing, dynamic day and night system, and the novelty of dynamic weather change! This system is supported by several other major maps as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/4c5138aa01359b8106aa9a9781f8212855bb5a69.jpg[/img]

In addition to this update contains many other innovations, such as new cars, changes in gameplay and so on. We will tell you more about it later and the release is very soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/61d45642b5f7a48f890765c1f60fc57f4b4e15a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Quality of life patch 2.8 and other platforms

The Xbox version of the game has been sent to Microsoft for certification and in the meantime the game has been updated to version 2.8 and today we're pushing it out for Steam as well.

Patch 2.8 for Steam improves the game's quality of life, touching on big changes to the behavior of opponents in races and other changes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/2ac482287e82c80cf3739cc842d36ddadb895ca7.jpg[/img]

- Changed joker tick trap, timer now decreases each time and automatic win for 1st place
- Some changes to career eventing
- Heavy objects (cars, columns, trees) have become slightly easier to destroy at speed
- The final arena with Woods has been simplified and the oil drum has been removed.
- Frank Woods' facial texture is slightly improved

notes.title: Big Patch Update + New Roulette Mode
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=fbIucZZpMY4;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey, drivers! We are unexpectedly back with a big update, which is designed to improve the quality of the game. Due to the porting of the game to consoles and other marketplaces, we have improved many aspects of the game and finalized some modes! ːMihalychRageː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/321003f24df2b922f779f55f9cffd3793ba52442.jpg[/img]

MAJOR CHANGES:

- Updated Roulette mode (new traps, scenes with Joker and Harley)
- Updated Dead Out mode (new enemies, new vehicles and alternate mode of all weapons)
- Added director mode to create your videos (invoked via photo mode or Tab in the game)
- Three new cars: Speed Zero, Astral X6, LKW
- New character skins: Joker and Harley, given out for 10 games with Joker's trap in Roulette
- Changes to the balance of game economy and career
- Expanded derby maps Cage and Frost, removed Abyss
- Other minor changes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/bd5cd7c0eab33aa1cea94e3356130309fcaa13b7.jpg[/img]

Roulette mode changes:

- Death or leaving the mode does not give money
- Added scenes with Joker and Harley
- Changed the list of machines and added new ones
- Random better selects the map and mode for the car
- The more often you play, the more interesting the traps will be
- Some traps have been reworked for the sake of the fan.
- New traps like helicopter with Joker, timer with bomb, no contact with opponents, race with 10 cars!
- Improved mode design, added voiceovers and subtitles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/3dceace0013d8318fbc7f04a6491124a057370db.jpg[/img]

Director mode: 

- Quick entry into photo mode! Tab or two joysticks together
- Possibility to enable Cinematic mode with different cameras
- Ability to control time and change cameras manually

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/1d2ad6a8739a27a98cb2b955e631cbe844715b55.jpg[/img]

Dead Out changes:

- New enemies and effects
- Added 4 other cars on the map, find them! (Azaza, OleGT, Pronco and a broken APC Tyran)
- Improved optimization and visuals, game balance and some changes on the map
- Gameplay for the main character has been improved, shooting has become easier
- Zombie damage has been improved, it's better to shoot at legs or head
- Added hand grenade for the main character
- Added an unusual enemy that comes to the map after killing the first boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/f51b7313ac188c37af8bda7b12dc7bb4d564963e.jpg[/img]

Main game changes:

- Added a new car Astral X6, Speed Zero and LKW
- Frost and Cage map derby are larger
- The action camera system has been redesigned and looks better
- Cars weight is now heavier and better at passing objects
- Added a penalty for intentionally using "reset on the road" in race and derby modes
- Rebalanced prices and levels in cars so that the long game progression doesn't interfere with the full experience for newcomers to the game
- Redesigned oil barrel (and toilet too), now there are more of them on the maps and they affect your tires more negatively
- Action camera is shown now sometimes on the billboards on the map as well
- More nitro is given in the air
- The third type of nitro also regenerates a bit during the game
- Added missing skins for the Badger
- The Walker GT car has been given the ability to turn on neon bottom lighting with a special skin (movie reference)
- Rear license plates are brighter at night
- Updated maps pool in career and some events
- Updated game shortcut icon (when you add it to your desktop, finally)
- Fans have been knocked down a little nicer and better body physics
- Added hair physics for some skins and cloth for Joker
- Removed different weather in the garage due to performance issues and low visibility
- Removed Abyss derby map from the game due to low popularity and outdated concept and visuals (too small map and too dark)

Fixes:

- Optimization improved in places
- Fixed a rare bug where a player could fly out of a car and hit the rear of another car at low speed
- Fixed an encountered bug with wheels in Monster Track
- Fixed a bug with nitro in SplitScreen mode for the second player
- Fixed rare bug with different race start in SplitScreen mode
- Fixed mono mode difficulty, by mistake AI could be a little better at tuning cars (especially on GoKart)
- Shopping cart got a small flashlight for dark maps
- Fixed "moonwalk" in running fans
- Improved overall system of calculating pilot's departure through a window or side door
- Fixed bug with inability to pass big water on small cars (due to ejection force)
- Fixed brightness issue on Nordringloop map
- Fixed a bug where a legless/headless driver could get up after dying
- Fixed a bug with Action Camera performance, in boss race mode the camera on the boss is shown more often
- Improved steam trap explosion, heavy vehicles are no longer thrown away by explosions.
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: The biggest update is here! Wild Roads & Trail Out v2.0!
notes.notes:
Hello drivers! Thanks for your long wait! After 4 months of hard work, we're back with the latest biggest update in Trail Out history! It's [b]Wild Roads[/b] and [b]Trail Out v2.0[/b]! ːMihalychRageː

[previewyoutube=uDPwmVkPUj8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Wild Roads:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Three huge new levels on the island of Madagascar! Race through jungles, beaches, villages, and safaris with animals, all while jumping and avoiding forest fires!
[*] New vehicles: Buggy Bag, Off Rover, Badger, and Bus
[*] Three secret character looks for Woods, Uber, and Mihalych. Find these secret spots on new maps to unlock them!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/391a623efde0502b12764e53afe8c976ee4b0b9f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Trail Out v2.0:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Redesigned driving, suspension, box, and engine physics. Cars now have weight and inertia and corners can be entered by drifting
[*] Reworked tuning so wheels matter for the surface they best fit
[*] Suspension has several types, both for sport tracks and derby
[*] Opponents in races are more willing to chase you, drive better, and make for improved competition
[*] Hunter Mode has been completely redesigned. Now, you play in a police car with different gadgets to eliminate opponents!
[*] Derbies have become friendlier and opponents have received more balanced damage
[*] [b]Due to an overhaul of car physics and other mechanics, map leaderboards have been reset[/b]
[*] Added small action cameras of enemies when you damage them!
[*] Improved car and driver damage system, now damage looks more brutal and even tears clothes!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/4c5ea7e9a82deec117dc71a35eb9f4687354f09e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/ec6283aa4888025e745902a17e8da3058372f276.gif[/img]

[code][u]Other changes:[/u] 

[list]
[*] All race maps have been updated and new interactive situations have been added (riding vehicles, new objects, or rearranging things)
[*] On the roads, there is a chance of meeting a fan who is trying to take your picture and will run away
[*] Some maps gained a system of day and night.
[*] Garage has a different day and an expanded maximum number of cars it can accommodate
[*] Leaderboards tables have gained the ability to see the car on which the record was set
[*] Leaderboards is now possible to view from the garage, directly in the menu of Free Race
[*] Added sorting cars by class in the garage
[*] A button for fast tuning before the race in the garage was added
[*] Career has been updated to reflect new maps
[*] Improved the effect of the wheels, allowing a car to leave traces on the ground
[*] Tuning of anti-tracking system for cars has been implemented
[*] More data about cars, tuning and maps in the garage
[*] Opponents have learned to answer your car horn or can honk at your back
[*] Cars now have the ability to turn on/off their headlights and some cars have the ability to hide their headlights
[*] Water now has an ejection effect and physical resistance
[*] There are handy tags for new content
[*] Improved interface
[*] Improved Discord status which shows more information
[*] Photo mode has been improved with a graphics enhanced mode button
[*] And many other changes and bug fixes!
[/list][/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41154827/a236aaaa865ce240c0f89e84526ccad334aaa0c2.jpg[/img]

This is the last major free Trail Out update, as per the Roadmap. Unfortunately, due to development difficulties and lack of resources, we are freezing multiplayer development until an indefinite time frame. We'll await the results of the update and focus on porting Trail Out to Playstation 5 and XBox Series S/X consoles. The system requirements for PC have been updated.

With that said, we've prepared the first DLC in the form of cars! [b]Thank you for your attention and support![/b] Have a great time with the new physics and racing under the scorching sun of Madagascar! ːMihalychː

[i]Please leave a review on Steam page if you liked the game! It will help us a lot.[/i]

notes.title: Big update for the demo!
notes.notes:
Racers, welcome!

We are publishing a new big update that will greatly improve your gaming experience!

Important:

- New driving physics! Turns, drifts have become something ordinary and pleasant, we are waiting for your feedback!
- Improved camera, shakes less, no longer interferes (Beta)
- SplitScreen mode is now up to 4 players! Try playing with friends on the same PC or through Steam Together. The mode is out of beta status, but there may be errors.
- Support for statistics among players! Your race records and other stats can now be compared with your friends and the rest of the world! (Beta, not all modes supported)
- Mihalych's legs are now on the pedals and will soon learn to press with his feet!

Minor changes:

- Support for Steam and Discord status when you play and what you do
- Improved optimization for weak computers
- Derby mode has become easier to play and damage to the attacker is less
- Minor fixes based on people's feedback

Looking forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix for demo!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you very much for your helpful tips and comments. We will take into account your wishes and will work hard on them. Your support is important to us! 💛

We are releasing a small update with changes:

- The weight of the machines became more and the damage began to be felt more strongly.
- A new darts trick has become available in the demo, score the most points.
- Enabled physics smoothing depending on FPS, should help players with weak hardware
- The duration of the demo has been increased to two hours.
- The camera has become a little faster, higher and less shaking.
- The stabilization of the car has become better, but more accurate when cornering at high speed, we will rework the settings of the car after the demo.

We are waiting for your new feedback and hope for your understanding that this is the first public beta within the framework of the demo festival, everything can change for the better by the release of the game.

[i]Good luck on the road! [/i]
